_comment: Artwork for social/calendar.json posts, never shipped with the site. Generate: node tools/generate-images.mjs --manifest=social/art.json --out=social/art [--only=<id> --force]. Then node tools/match-ground.mjs social/art/<id>.webp, and trim the empty margin to the drawing plus 3% so it fills the slide (12 Oct 2026: done with sharp trim against #020d1c).

slots.prompt: A still product picture becoming a video: on the left a single flat picture card showing a simple product block on a plain ground; to its right three successive frames of the same picture step outward, each a little further along, ending in a tall vertical video frame with a small cyan play triangle at its centre. Objects only: no people, no hands, no faces. A mid-shot: every object drawn large but whole and readable, the group spanning the full width of the frame with an even dark margin on every side, nothing cropped. Every corner is square, nothing rounded. Light shapes are cool grey #8ba3bd; white only on small details, never a large white fill. Cyan on no more than about five percent of the frame, only on one small element, never a large cyan shape. Lines of writing anywhere are drawn as plain grey bars with no letters.
